top_signals.title: Barrick Chairman's Planned Overhaul Meets Investor Backlash
top_signals.summary: John Thornton appeared ready last year to step down as chairman of Barrick Mining Corp. after a turbulent 12-year tenure. Instead, he seized control from his long-time CEO and is now driving a reinvention of one of the world’s largest gold producers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Military device manufacturer discloses cyber incident to SEC
top_signals.summary: IEH Corporation — which produces specialized products used in military satellites, missiles and fighter jets — said it discovered a cyberattack on Tuesday and immediately tried to contain it.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Green notice 2026/02
top_signals.summary: Green notices cover significant and/or significant proposals for Bank of England reporting. If any of these proposals are finalised and are to be implemented, they will appear in a statistical notice.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Duke Energy Seeks $1.75 Billion From Equity Units Sale
top_signals.summary: Duke Energy Corp. plans to raise about $1.75 billion by selling equity units, in an effort to pay down debt.
